hooks.command:
exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run.sh" -Mode auto
if ([Console]::IsInputRedirected) { $env:MEMROTATE_HOOK_INPUT = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() }; powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/rotate.ps1" -Mode auto

exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run.sh" -Mode backup -Quiet
if ([Console]::IsInputRedirected) { $env:MEMROTATE_HOOK_INPUT = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() }; powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/rotate.ps1" -Mode backup -Quiet

exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run.sh" -Mode stop
if ([Console]::IsInputRedirected) { $env:MEMROTATE_HOOK_INPUT = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() }; powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/rotate.ps1" -Mode stop

exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run.sh" -Mode backup -Quiet
if ([Console]::IsInputRedirected) { $env:MEMROTATE_HOOK_INPUT = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() }; powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/rotate.ps1" -Mode backup -Quiet
